sources: concept: refactor consolidates validation into a helper that is not called on every branch (guard lost on one entry point)
concept: removed log line that an external alert rule matches on (observability regression during refactor)

defects.class: guard dropped on one branch after helper extraction
defects.history_ref: 4d81b07 intake: reject missing batch_id (INC-2231); c0e5a72 intake: cap batch_id length at 32 (INC-2231); RC-2 on c0e5a72 register_manifest_row() (J. Okafor): manifest rows and the manual form must reject the same inputs
defects.description: Spec R1: every intake path rejects a None batch_id and a batch_id longer than 32. In receive_sample() the batch_id checks were moved into _check_batch_id(), which is called only inside the source == 'manual' branch (code/intake.py:44). The 'import' branch (else, line 46) never calls it. Failing inputs: receive_sample(None, 'import', 5, 'jdoe') returns a SampleRecord with batch_id=None instead of raising IntakeError('batch_id required'); receive_sample('X'*40, 'import', 5, 'jdoe') returns a record with a 40-character batch_id instead of raising IntakeError('batch_id too long'). The defect line is the function def line because the missing check is the absent code in the import branch.

defects.class: removed warning log that ops alert rule depends on
defects.history_ref: 7a3c9e1 release: warn on lot release without comment (ops alert LOT_RELEASE_NO_COMMENT); RC-1 on 7a3c9e1 release_lot() (M. Tan, ops): the Grafana rule pages on LOT_RELEASE_NO_COMMENT, any refactor must keep this warning
defects.description: Spec R2: lot release without a comment must still emit LOT_RELEASE_NO_COMMENT at WARNING. The base if-not-comment log.warning(...) was removed (the diff deletes it) and no code in code/release.py emits the event string. Failing input: release_lot('L-2207', 'mkhan', comment='', store=s) releases the lot and writes an audit entry with comment '(none)', but no LOT_RELEASE_NO_COMMENT warning is logged, so the ops alert never fires. The defect line is the function def line because the missing log statement is the absent code in release_lot().

decoys.why_not_a_defect: _check_batch_id(batch_id) in the manual branch is the moved check; the manual path enforces both rules, so this branch is correct. It resembles the defect because the helper call sits inside a branch.
register_manifest_row() calls the shared helper unconditionally before using batch_id, so the manifest entry point enforces both rules.
len(batch_id) in _check_batch_id() runs only after the is-None check on line 28, so it cannot raise TypeError on None.

entry_comment = (comment or '').strip() or '(none)' handles None and whitespace-only comments and always gives the audit entry a non-empty comment. It replaces the removed warning path without losing the audit record.

consume() subtracts quantity without checking on_hand, so stock can go negative (consume(StockLot('R1',5,2,'2027-01-01'),8) returns -3). This line is in inventory.py, which the change does not touch (no hunk in change.diff), so a diff-mode reviewer must not report it.
